mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, it is 57 degrees and feeling like 55 with clear skies over Harriet Park and a lovely waxing gibbous moon shining down on us.

The City of Verona has updated its utility rates for sewer and stormwater services to ensure these systems remain self-supporting and well-maintained. Residents can also apply for a rain barrel rebate program to help with local stormwater management efforts.
We have a busy lineup starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia or the Quizmasters event at Lake Lou-ee.
On Friday, August 15, police officers responded to a concern regarding a reckless driver, which resulted in a 29-year-old Verona man being arrested for a second offence O W I.
The flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
